beaches.name: Little Banana (Mikri Banana / Spartacus)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the whole beach, most bathers nude. A naturist directory carries near-annual visitor reports from 1998 to June 2024; a September 2022 report says police briefly ordered bathers to dress after a water-sports operator complained, with nude use resuming the next day.

beaches.name: Megas Aselinos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the far end, away from the taverna and sunbeds. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2013 to June 2024; reports note the near end is used by local families and ask nude bathers to keep clear of it.

beaches.name: Mandraki
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the ends of the beach; the middle is swimwear. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to July 2021; numbers vary by season and several visits found no nude bathers.
